What's Inside

Everything You Need to Stay on Track

Twelve purpose-built tools designed around how Indian students actually prepare — from daily planning to exam-day analytics.

Dashboard

A single command center that pulls your progress, streaks and upcoming tasks into one clear view.

Daily Planner

Plan every day with time-blocked tasks so you always know exactly what to study next.

Study Hours

Log and visualize the hours you put in daily, weekly and monthly to build real consistency.

Habit Tracker

Build winning routines — sleep, revision, mock tests — and track your streaks day after day.

Subject Manager

Organize every subject and chapter with completion status so nothing in your syllabus slips through.

Goal Tracker

Set short-term and long-term exam goals, then watch your progress bar move as you hit each one.

Mock Test Tracker

Record every mock test score and instantly see your accuracy and improvement trend over time.

Weekly Analytics

Get a clear weekly breakdown of hours studied, tests taken and habits kept — all in visual charts.

Priority Planner

Rank tasks by urgency and importance so high-weightage topics always get tackled first.

Works Offline

No internet? No problem. Every feature runs fully offline so you can study anywhere, anytime.

Responsive

A fluid layout that looks and works beautifully on your phone, tablet and laptop alike.

Local Storage

All your data stays securely on your own device — private, persistent, and always available.
